nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Fair access to green jobs_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Which groups are mentioned as being more affected by eco-grief?
nodes.answer: Youth and individuals working or studying in environmental and land-based fields are identified as being more affected by eco-grief.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Fair access to green jobs_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can policymakers address the potential unemployment crisis in the fossil fuel-based energy generation sector during the transition to renewable energy sources?
nodes.answer: Policymakers can introduce skill-development facilities to help workers in the fossil fuel-based energy sector develop new skills and transition to employment opportunities in the renewable energy sector, thereby mitigating the unemployment crisis.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Fair access to green jobs_qna_002
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What percentage of the funds from the Next Generation EU programme is proposed to be allocated to the green transition in Spain?
nodes.answer: 39% of the funds that Spain receives under the Next Generation EU programme is proposed to be assigned to the green transition.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Fair access to green jobs_qna_003
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What percentage of the Next Generation EU funds is proposed to be assigned to the green transition according to the RTRP?
nodes.answer: The RTRP proposes assigning 39% of the funds to the green transition.
